ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Path In Keyboard Layout IME File Registry Value
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects usage of Windows Input Method Editor (IME) keyboard layout feature, which allows an attacker to load a DLL into the process after sending the WM_INPUTLANGCHANGEREQUEST message.
Before doing this, the client needs to register the DLL in a special registry key that is assumed to implement this keyboard layout. This registry key should store a value named "Ime File" with a DLL path.
IMEs are essential for languages that have more characters than can be represented on a standard keyboard, such as Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
 Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\Keyboard\\ Layouts\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*Ime\\ File.*")) AND ((Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*")) OR ((Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND Details = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites\\\\.*")) OR (Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND Details = RGX(".*\\\\Favourites\\\\.*")) OR (Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND Details = RGX(".*\\\\Contacts\\\\.*"))))
